summary: The magnets in the hat can detach and fall out, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. title: Doll Clothing Sets Recalled by Manhattan Group Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the pajama pants contain excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 9,200.

title: OKK Trading Recalls Toy Army Figures Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the face of the Army figures contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 5,400.

title: Hockey Helmets Recalled by Reebok-CCM Due to Head and Neck Injury Hazard
summary: The helmet's chinstrap can unexpectedly disengage while in use. If this happens, the helmet can fall off, posing a head and neck injury risk to consumers. Units: About 1,000.

title: Children's Jewelry Sold Exclusively in Hawaii Recalled by Aloha 808 Trading Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 12,800.

title: Evenflo Recalls Majestic High Chairs Due to Fall and Choking Hazards
summary: Plastic caps and metal screws on both sides of the high chair can loosen and fall out, posing both fall and choking hazards to children. Plastic caps and screws that become loose and fall out can cause the seatback to suddenly fall back or detach from the high chair. Children can fall out or collide

title: Fingerhut Recalls Chef's Mark Cookware Sets Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The handles on the cookware can break, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,000.

title: Grease Removers Recalled by Fantastic Distributors Due to Chemical Burn Hazard
summary: Direct contact with this substance can cause burns to consumers' skin and eyes. The product lacks required special packaging and warning label. Units: About 245,000.

title: Regal Lager Recall to Replace Phil & Teds Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The frame handle could fail to latch properly and break, posing a fall hazard to small children. Units: 1600.

title: Xtreme Toy Zone Recalls Toy Dinosaurs Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the toy dinosaurs can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 480.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The mounting hardware securing the fuel pump can allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: Commercial Frozen Food Merchandisers Recalled by Tyler Refrigeration Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Incomplete/incorrect light bulb installation can result in electrical arcing in the fixture, which can pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,900.

title: Propane Gas Fireplace Inserts Recalled by Wolf Steel Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Delayed ignition due to a build-up of propane gas can cause the insert's glass cover to break, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,200.

title: The Toro Company Reannounces Recall of Electric Blowers Due to Projectile Hazards
summary: The blower's impeller, which is a rotating component on the blower, can break, resulting in pieces of plastic flying out of the blower. This poses a risk of serious injury to the user or a bystander. Units: About 900,000.

title: Boys Reversible Vests Recalled by Bon-Ton Stores Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The zipper tabs on these vests fail to meet the children's torques test standards, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 5,000.

title: Faulty Instructions Prompt Recall of Electrical Wiring How-to-Books by The Taunton Press; Shock Hazard to Consumers
summary: The books contain several errors in the technical diagrams that could lead consumers to incorrectly install or repair electrical wiring, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 64,000.

title: Fire Alarm Control Panels Recalled by Notifier Due to Alert Failure
summary: The software in the fire alarm system could fail to process an alarm condition which could result in the system failing to respond in the event of a fire. Units: About 2,000.

title: Atomic Skis USA Recalls Ski Bindings Due to Unexpected Release, Fall Hazard
summary: The heel housing of the bindings can crack, causing the binding to release unexpectedly. This can cause the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 125,000 (an additional 1.0 million were sold outside the U.S.).

title: Foursquare Recalls Hooded Youth Jackets with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 12,800.

title: Gardener's Supply Company Recalls Candle-Powered Carousels Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candle holder placement on the base of the carousels is too close to the structure, allowing the candle flame to come in contact and ignite different parts of the carousel, including the fans, trees and deer, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Hallmark Recalls Jumbo Snow Globes Due to Fire Hazard
summary: When exposed to sunlight, the snow globe can act as a magnifying glass and ignite nearby combustible materials, posing a fire hazard. Units: 7000.

title: Magura USA Recalls Bicycle Suspension Forks Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The front bicycle suspension fork can break, causing the rider to crash. Units: About 320.

title: Munire Recalls "Newport Rubbed Black" Cribs and Matching Furniture Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The red paint which is underneath the black finish paint on some of the cribs and matching furniture exceeds federal lead limits. If ingested by young children lead can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 3,000 Cribs and 6,000 Matching Furniture Pieces.

title: Teknion Recalls to Repair Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolts holding the seat to the frame can loosen and separate, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 60,000.

title: Woodstock Percussion Inc. Recalls Toy Drums Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the recalled toy drums contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 2,800.
